title: template → editor opens with the "tell me what to put in your slides" popup
"Skip" closes the popup, keeps the sample, and the popup does not return on reload
brief → every slide is rewritten from the user's details (not the sample), same design, with pictures
pictures: none are broken or empty frames; a slide without a matching picture is a clean text slide (a missing picture beats a wrong one)
the previous version is kept in Version history (restore possible)
AI assistant: "update all slides with my content" rebuilds the WHOLE deck (not just slide 1)
